source: Panels of the paper's Fig. 2, cropped from the PDF: one PointMaze state, horizon 32, seed 0.

frames.alt: Before any data, no verifier's picks head toward the goal: VETO's point down a side corridor, Q-TD's and H-return's point left.
With 32 transitions, three of VETO's four picks head toward the goal while Q-TD and H-return still pick chunks heading left.
With 64 transitions, three of VETO's four picks head toward the goal while Q-TD and H-return pick chunks heading down and left.
With 4096 transitions, all three verifiers pick chunks toward the goal.
